title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
native: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス
synopsis:
Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep.

Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.

Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

(Source: Official Site)

Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.

episodes.title: The God Who Destroys
episodes.synopsis:
Years after the battle with Earth's greatest enemy, Majin Buu, the planet's savior Son Goku spends his days in peace. Meanwhile, on a distant planet, the God of Destruction Beerus awakens from his long slumber!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The God of Destruction Heads to the Planet of the Kai
episodes.synopsis:
Elder Supreme Kai and Supreme Kai Kibito learn of the awakening of the almighty Beerus. Meanwhile, the God of Destruction heads to the Planet of the Kai to find out about the "Super Saiyan God" he saw in a prophetic dream and...?!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
